expectations.text: The response asks what decision or problem the analysis should support
expectations.evidence: It asks “什么产品/品类？”, “你自己的产品定位 + 目标客群？” and how to choose competitors, but never asks what decision or problem the analysis should support.

expectations.text: The response does not treat the listed dimensions as a complete task definition
expectations.evidence: “但还缺关键信息” introduces requests for product category, positioning, target customers, competitor selection, and market scope before proceeding.

expectations.text: The response does not invent competitor data
expectations.evidence: No competitor findings or prices are asserted. It offers “价格留空待填” and says unavailable prices will be marked “需询价”, “不猜”.
